foot.not_advice: It is not medical advice. It cannot diagnose. If you think someone is having a stroke, call your local emergency number. Nothing here should start, stop or change a medicine, a therapy or a care plan without your own doctor or stroke team. The NIHSS, ICH score, ABCD2, CHA2DS2-VASc, ASPECTS and other scales are for learning, never for an individual's diagnosis, prognosis or treatment. Doses, thresholds and guideline statements are quoted as published by the AHA/ASA, ESO, NICE and drug labels, never as instructions, and outcome figures are population statistics, not predictions for any person. Please check the original sources, which are listed in full in the Sources module.
shell.disclaimer: The Stroke Companion is an educational synthesis of published literature for study and understanding. If you think someone is having a stroke, call your local emergency number. It does not replace a doctor, nurse, physiotherapist, occupational therapist, speech and language therapist or the rest of a stroke team. Scores such as the NIHSS, ICH score, ABCD2, CHA2DS2-VASc and ASPECTS are teaching aids, never for an individual's diagnosis, prognosis or treatment. Doses, thresholds and guideline statements are quoted as published, never as instructions. Outcomes are population statistics; they are not predictions for any person.
shell.note: An animated, cited guide for students, people who have had a stroke, and their families and carers. Educational only, not medical advice. Your place is saved on this device.
